title: refactor: remove dead application code
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes unused Chat components, CSS, assets, accent storage, and a no-op serialization layer.
- Removes unused Reimagine compatibility services/types, Discord scaffolding, and main-frontend news/icons/UI primitives.
- Removes 3,072 net lines across 35 files (58 additions, 3,130 deletions).

Checks:
- Chat production build and nested-image storage round-trip
- Chat lint improves from 14 existing findings on `main` to 13
- Discord TypeScript build
- Main frontend TypeScript and production build
- Reimagine changed-file typecheck has the same three pre-existing errors as `main`
- Repository-wide removed-symbol/import scan
- Biome and `git diff --check`

gist.headline: The dead code compost heap
gist.blurb: 3,072 lines of unused scaffolding have been returned to the garden. The surviving code has more room to grow.
gist.summary: Removed 3,072 net lines of unused Chat components and styling, Reimagine compatibility services and types, Discord scaffolding, and dormant main-site news and UI primitives across 35 files.
gist.impact: Chat, Reimagine, the Discord bot, and the main frontend keep their existing behavior while carrying less obsolete code, fewer stale imports, and a smaller maintenance surface.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a careful garden keeper in a tiny tool belt, pruning dry branches labeled as old UI components from a thriving code-garden. A friendly CRT monitor robot holds a compost bin of retired code snippets while healthy lime-green code-plants remain in the background, representing a cleaner repository without changing the living product.
